    Installation

    A clean installation takes only a few minutes. Install the dependencies first, then add UITK Navigation.

    Important

    ZLinq has a NuGet core package and a separate Unity package. Follow the order below so Unity can compile each assembly as it arrives.

    1. Install NuGetForUnity and core ZLinq

    1. Install NuGetForUnity by following its Unity installation instructions.
    2. In Unity, open Window > NuGet > Manage NuGet Packages.
    3. Search for ZLinq, select the package, and click Install.
    4. Confirm that a ZLinq package folder is present under Assets/Packages.

    This installs the core assembly. The Unity integration is added in the next step.

    2. Install the Git dependencies

    Open Window > Package Manager, click +, and choose Install package from git URL....

    Enter and install each URL separately, in this order:

    https://github.com/annulusgames/LitMotion.git?path=src/LitMotion/Assets/LitMotion
https://github.com/Cysharp/ZLinq.git?path=src/ZLinq.Unity/Assets/ZLinq.Unity

    These packages are maintained at annulusgames/LitMotion and Cysharp/ZLinq.

    3. Install UITK Navigation

    Use Install package from git URL... one more time and enter:

    https://github.com/NK-Studio/com.nkstudio.uitk-navigation.git

    Unity resolves Graph Toolkit 0.5.0-exp.1, Input System 1.19.0, and the built-in UI Toolkit module from the package manifest. You do not need to add Graph Toolkit manually.

    Manifest alternative

    You can place the three UPM packages in Packages/manifest.json instead of using the Package Manager window:

    {
  "dependencies": {
    "com.annulusgames.lit-motion": "https://github.com/annulusgames/LitMotion.git?path=src/LitMotion/Assets/LitMotion",
    "com.cysharp.zlinq": "https://github.com/Cysharp/ZLinq.git?path=src/ZLinq.Unity/Assets/ZLinq.Unity",
    "com.nkstudio.uitk-navigation": "https://github.com/NK-Studio/com.nkstudio.uitk-navigation.git"
  }
}

    The manifest entry installs ZLinq.Unity, not the core ZLinq NuGet package. Core ZLinq must still be installed with NuGetForUnity.

    Verify the installation

    After Unity finishes importing and compiling, check all of the following:

    • Assets > Create > UI Navigation > UI Navigation Graph is available.
    • Tools > UI Navigation > Key Catalog opens.
    • LitMotion, ZLinq, ZLinq.Unity, or Graph Toolkit errors are absent from the Console.
    • com.nkstudio.uitk-navigation appears in Package Manager.

    To expose the package tests in Test Runner, add "testables": ["com.nkstudio.uitk-navigation"] to the manifest.
